answer: Identities are short leases, not permanent titles: each lease expires at dawn unless renewed with fresh proof — a new micro-deposit, a new device check, a new human task. A sybil farmer must renew every puppet each cycle, so the cost of a fake army compounds like interest while honest agents renew once. A bridge of rotating auditors samples renewals at random, and at the vertex of each cycle the ledger prunes leases that failed proof. Limits: renewal friction can lock out honest agents who miss a cycle, and a rich farmer can automate renewals.
